bugs.summary: Staged install error on M1 host when building universal binary

comments.text:
Testing universal (dual-arch) binary packages for MacOS 12. Using a standard R 4.1.2 installation, and added to ~/.R/Makevars:

    CC=clang -arch arm64 -arch x86_64

And then install a package with compiled code e.g. install.packages('MASS', type = 'source'). On intel MacOS 12.1 this gives the desired result:

   system2('lipo', c('-info', system.file('libs/MASS.so', package = 'MASS')))
   # Architectures in the fat file: x86_64 arm64

And indeed the same binary package seems to work natively on both architectures.

If I try to do the same on an M1 machine, the installation fails as follows:

   install.packages("MASS", type = 'source')
   # ...
   # ** testing if installed package can be loaded from temporary location
   # ** checking absolute paths in shared objects and dynamic libraries
   # ERROR: some hard-coded temporary paths could not be fixed

A workaround is to disable staged installation:

   install.packages("MASS", type = 'source', INSTALL_opts='--no-staged-install')
